title: Figure 15: Air-to-space laser Lightcraft concept against ballistic missiles
description: Schematic titled "Air-to-Space (Ballistic Threats)" showing an "Air Launch: H ~ 12 km, V ~ M 0.8" aircraft beaming a laser to a Lightcraft on a dashed path toward "Enemy Ballistic Missiles" above Earth's curve. Caption: "Figure 15. Air-to-Space Concept: Appropriate rotation and translation of a high-energy laser beam, emanating from a moving aircraft, guides and propels a Lightcraft toward a nearly head-on collision with an incoming ballistic missile..." The page continues with assumed laser and trajectory limitations.
